summary: Lloyds Banking Group filed a Form 6-K reporting the purchase of 6,925,854 of its ordinary shares on 20 May 2026 as part of an existing buyback programme. Shares were bought from Goldman Sachs International at an average price of 97.008 pence per share, with a highest price of 98.0 pence and lowest of 96.18 pence. The programme was announced on 30 January 2026 and the shares are intended to be cancelled. No board recommendation or advisor is named. This is a routine open-market buyback executed under a mandate; there is no tender offer, premium, or special committee. The risk-arb angle is minimal as the buyback is pre-announced and procedural.
